messages.text: yo john, amara here. jumping on the raft team for testing. how do you want the fault injector? drop/delay/partition/kill or are we doing something fancy?
hey amara. keep it simple please. just a wrapper around the rpc layer so we can intercept messages before they hit the wire.
ok ok ok. so i inject faults at the transport boundary? that means partitioning is just dropping packets in one direction until we heal it?
yeah basically. i need to be able to force split votes after a partition heals later, so make sure you can re-enable the link cleanly.
noted. i'll add a 'heal' command that restores full connectivity. should i also support random delay jitter or just fixed ms?
fixed is fine for now. we can add jitter if the linearizability tests get weird. focus on drop and partition first.
cool. i'll have a stub ready by thursday. what format do you want the test cases in? json config or code?
json please. easier to review and we can generate them later if needed. thanks amara.
